The force reached Cairo on 23 April, ahead of the brigade Cameron had asked for (Adjutant General's report p7 prints both telegrams). Decisive action on his own initiative: supports above, not more.

Yates at the Springfield Jubilee 20 Nov 1860: "slavery is the creature of a local law" and of the Territories "they shall remain forever free, and by the blessing of God, the clank of no slave-chain shall ever be heard upon that broad domain." His own speech is conduct showing the value, dated before the boundary. The pamphlet OCR shows no page numbers.
